edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the privileged owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring privileges.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity determines the source balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall stores allowance for msg.sender and forwards it to the external callback.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
acceptOwnership validates and then clears the pending newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry for the caller and spender.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
totalSupply derives its return value from _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner and sends tokens to owner.
approveAndCall invokes external code on an arbitrary spender contract after writing allowance.
Control returns from the untrusted callback back into approveAndCall before it returns true.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary, possibly malicious token contract.
Control returns from the external token transfer back into transferAnyERC20Token.
safeAdd performs the raw addition c = a + b that can overflow in Solidity 0.4.x.
First operand parameter a flows into the unchecked addition.
Second operand parameter b flows into the unchecked addition.
The addition result is stored in the return local variable c.
Recipient parameter to is credited in transfer.

Spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
Amount parameter tokens is written into the allowance slot in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens drives the balance and allowance decrements in transferFrom.
Spender parameter becomes both the allowance key and the external call target.
Amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes parameter data is forwarded through approveAndCall.
Caller-supplied tokenAddress becomes the target of the external ERC20 call.
Amount parameter tokens is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter a is the left operand of the safeAdd computation.
Parameter b is the right operand of the safeAdd computation.
Local c is returned as the result of safeAdd.
Token amount parameter of approveAndCall is forwarded into the untrusted callback.
Attacker-controlled data bytes are passed verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary tokenAddress parameter determines which external contract receives the call.
Amount parameter is passed to the external contract that may re-enter.
